content: Vikram Singh from ProtectAll Agency confirmed to customer Kiara Sen that her laptop receipt has been received and added to her personal-property coverage ($5,000 electronics limit within her $150,000 total limit). Kiara also inquired about coverage for her new smartwatch, and Vikram informed her that wearables are covered up to $2,000 with a receipt, at no extra premium. Kiara agreed to email the smartwatch receipt later.

action_items: Kiara to email the receipt for her new smartwatch to the agent
